BrochureContent.Content:
Sherry FitzGerald O'Donovan are delighted to present to the market The Cottage, Soreeney, Co. Clare.

A charming four-bedroom detached cottage set on approximately 1.1 acres in a peaceful rural setting. Offering comfortable accommodation together with generous outdoor space, this property presents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, those looking to downsize or anyone seeking country living within easy reach of local amenities.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall, a cosy living room, a kitchen and dining area, four well-proportioned bedrooms and two bathrooms. The layout is practical and functional, providing comfortable living with plenty of scope for a new owner to personalise the property over time.

Externally, the property sits on a generous 1.1-acre site with mature gardens surrounding the home. A stone driveway provides ample off-street parking, while the spacious grounds offer excellent potential for gardening, outdoor activities or simply enjoying the peaceful countryside setting.

The Cottage enjoys a convenient location in Soreeney, offering the tranquillity of rural living while remaining just a short drive from nearby towns and villages. Newmarket-on-Fergus, Shannon and Ennis are all within easy reach, while the M18 motorway and Shannon Airport provide excellent connectivity for commuters.

Additional features include solid fuel fired heating, PVC double glazed windows, a stone driveway with ample off-street parking, mature gardens and a generous 1.1-acre site. This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a detached home in a scenic countryside location with plenty of outdoor space and excellent potential.
